definitions.new_lease_rent_m2: Median monthly rent per m2 of the new lease contracts for family dwellings registered with the tax authority in the year (INE, method 2026); contracts signed, not the rents of all tenants
definitions.census_mean_rent: Mean monthly rent of all rented classic dwellings of usual residence at the census date (old and new contracts, social rents included)
definitions.hicp_actual_rentals: Eurostat HICP, COICOP 04.1 actual rentals for housing, 2015=100: price change of rents paid by tenants, a quality-adjusted index, not a rent level
definitions.m2_per_month_of_income: Median gross household income / 12 / median new-lease rent per m2: floor area that one month of median income would rent at the median new-lease rate. A ratio of medians from different populations; not the rent any household pays
definitions.overburden: Share of people living in households whose housing costs, net of housing allowances, exceed 40% of disposable income, net of housing allowances (EU-SILC)
definitions.asking_rents: No official statistics of advertised rents exist; portal listings are not used
